description: Source code for disk cache statistics management, including structures, functions for verifying, initializing, serializing, and analyzing cache statistics, as well as managing counters and size buckets.

classes.name: disk_cache::Stats
classes.description: Class managing cache statistics, counters, and size buckets, including initialization, serialization, and analysis methods.

methods.name: VerifyStats
methods.description: Verifies the integrity of OnDiskStats data based on signature and size.

methods.name: Stats::Init
methods.description: Initializes Stats object from raw data, verifying and copying relevant data.

methods.name: Stats::InitSizeHistogram
methods.description: Initializes size histogram for cache data sizes.

methods.name: Stats::StorageSize
methods.description: Returns the storage size needed for stats.

methods.name: Stats::ModifyStorageStats
methods.description: Updates data size buckets based on old and new sizes.

methods.name: Stats::OnEvent
methods.description: Increments counters for specific cache events.

methods.name: Stats::SetCounter
methods.description: Sets the value of a specific counter.

methods.name: Stats::GetCounter
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a specific counter.

methods.name: Stats::GetItems
methods.description: Populates a list with key-value pairs of size buckets and counters.

methods.name: Stats::ResetRatios
methods.description: Resets specific counters related to cache ratios.

methods.name: Stats::GetLargeEntriesSize
methods.description: Calculates total size of large cache entries.

methods.name: Stats::SerializeStats
methods.description: Serializes current stats into a data buffer.

methods.name: Stats::GetBucketRange
methods.description: Returns size range for a given bucket index.

methods.name: Stats::GetStatsBucket
methods.description: Determines bucket index for a given size.

methods.name: Stats::GetRatio
methods.description: Calculates ratio of hit to total attempts for cache counters.
